tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Verify the API key and return the authenticated workspace: name, plan, email quota (used/limit), and owner. Call this first to confirm the key works before sending. Pair with list_domains to see which `from` addresses are allowed.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a transactional email through Send16. Provide `html`, `text`, or both (text-only is fine for OTPs/receipts/alerts). `from_email` must belong to a domain that is verified in the workspace; call `whoami` for the account and `list_domains` to see which senders are allowed; a send from an unverifie

tools.name: send_campaign_test
tools.description: Send a test email for an existing campaign to preview how it will look in recipients' inboxes. Confirm the test address with the user first. Can be refused with 403 SENDING_PAUSED (workspace under review, nothing was sent, tell the user to contact support).

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a new email campaign as a draft: optionally with full HTML content and recipients (exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll) so it's ready to test and send. Nothing is sent until schedule_campaign.

tools.name: design_email_template
tools.description: Use AI to generate a complete email HTML template based on a description. Returns ready-to-use HTML that can be sent or used in campaigns.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List email campaigns, newest first. Use `search` to find a past campaign the user describes vaguely ('the invite one', 'that July newsletter'); it matches name and subject case-insensitively; try distinctive words from their description and broaden if no hits.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Add a single new contact, optionally straight into audiences and/or with tags; e.g. 'add this person from my email into the newsletter list'. Contacts are subscribed by default. For more than a handful of people, use import_contacts instead.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by email address or name. Returns matching contacts with their tags and subscription status.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List all contacts with optional filtering by subscription status and tag. Supports pagination.

tools.name: import_contacts
tools.description: Bulk import contacts from CSV data (min column: email), optionally straight into audiences and/or with tags. This is the tool for cross-app flows; e.g. pulling people out of Gmail, a CRM, or a spreadsheet and landing them in a Send16 audience in one call. Set updateExisting for upsert semantics (saf

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List all sending domains configured in your Send16 workspace, including their verification status and DNS records.

tools.name: check_domain_health
tools.description: Check the DNS health of a specific domain, including DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and MX record verification status. Triggers a fresh DNS lookup.

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Get detailed performance statistics for a specific campaign including open rate, click rate, bounce rate, and delivery metrics.

tools.name: get_deliverability_status
tools.description: Get your workspace's deliverability summary: sending reputation, domain authentication status, and recent bounce/complaint health. (Deliverability Hub plan feature.)

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List all automations in the workspace, including draft/active/paused status and trigger types.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.description: Get a single automation by ID, including its trigger, steps, and current status.

tools.name: enroll_in_automation
tools.description: Manually enroll a contact in an active automation. The automation must be in 'active' status. Use send_event for event-driven enrollment. Confirm with the user first: the automation can start emailing the contact straight away.

tools.name: send_event
tools.description: Fire a custom event for a contact. Automations whose trigger is `{type:'custom_event', eventName:'<name>'}` will enroll the contact and start running. Payload is exposed to condition steps as `event.<key>`. Confirm with the user first if the event could start an automation that emails the contact.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List starter-gallery email templates available to every workspace.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save an email design as a reusable template in the user's Send16 workspace. Use this when the user has designed an email (for example in a Claude artifact) and wants it in Send16. Pass the complete email HTML. Send16 hosts every image (remote URLs and inline data: images), converts merge tags like {

tools.name: list_workspace_templates
tools.description: List the templates saved in the user's own Send16 workspace (their template library, including ones saved with save_template). For the shared starter gallery use list_templates.

tools.name: send_template_test
tools.description: Send a preview of a saved workspace template to one email address, so the user can see it in a real inbox. It arrives from noreply@send16.com with a small 'Template test preview' banner and uses sample merge values (first name 'Test'). Only send to the user's own address unless they ask otherwise. C

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get a single starter template by ID, including its EmailContent JSON.

tools.name: render_email_content
tools.description: Compile an EmailContent JSON object (the shape used by the Send16 builder + templates) into HTML using the platform's authoritative renderer. Returns the exact HTML the API would send. Useful for previews and post-processing.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Register a new sending domain. Returns the DNS records the user must add to their DNS provider, after which they should call check_domain_health to verify.

tools.name: pre_send_review
tools.description: Run an AI pre-send review on an email's HTML before sending. Surfaces tone issues, broken links, missing alt text, spam triggers, and accessibility problems.

tools.name: generate_email_from_url
tools.description: Scrape a URL (e.g. a launch blog post or product page) and generate an email draft from its content. Returns subject, preview text, and HTML body.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages from the unified send log (transactional + campaign). Filter by recipient, sender, status, date range, or source.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Fetch a single message with its full event timeline (created → sent → delivered → opened → clicked → ...).

tools.name: get_message_events
tools.description: Get just the delivery event timeline for a message: no body or recipient details.

tools.name: list_convos
tools.description: List inbox conversations. Filter by state, mailbox, label, screener status, or full-text search. Send16's unified inbox combines transactional reply threading with team-managed shared inboxes.

tools.name: get_convo
tools.description: Get a single conversation with its full thread of posts (incoming + outgoing).

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Reply to an inbox conversation. The reply is sent from the original recipient address (the alias the convo arrived on) and threaded back to the contact. Show the user the reply text and get a clear yes first: it goes to a real person and cannot be unsent. Can be refused with 403 SENDING_PAUSED (work

tools.name: mark_convo_read
tools.description: Mark a conversation as read for the current viewer.

tools.name: update_convo
tools.description: Update conversation status (open/closed/archived/snoozed) or assignee.

tools.name: add_convo_note
tools.description: Add a private internal note on a conversation. Notes are visible only to workspace members.

tools.name: screener_decide
tools.description: Decide a pending screener conversation (first-time sender). 'allow' lets future emails through, 'reject' blocks, 'cold' marks as cold outreach.

tools.name: list_inbox_counts
tools.description: Get unread/total counts per category and label for the inbox sidebar (newsletter, transactional, marketing, calendar, social, cold).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List subscription topics. Topics are granular categories contacts can subscribe to (e.g. 'product-updates', 'weekly-digest'). Campaigns and automations can be gated to subscribers of a specific topic.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a new subscription topic. Contacts opt into topics individually via the preference center.

tools.name: update_topic
tools.description: Update a subscription topic (name, description, default).

tools.name: delete_topic
tools.description: Delete a subscription topic. All subscribers will be detached.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List Actions. Actions fire a transactional template when a custom event arrives: simple 'event_name → template' pairings, lighter than full automations.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get a single Action with its trigger config and template binding.

tools.name: create_action
tools.description: Create an Action that maps an event name to a transactional template. Each matching event sends one email to the contact.

tools.name: update_action
tools.description: Update an Action (toggle enabled, change template, change event name).

tools.name: delete_action
tools.description: Delete an Action.

tools.name: list_audiences
tools.description: List audiences (lists). An audience is a static, manually-managed group of contacts.

tools.name: create_audience
tools.description: Create a new audience.

tools.name: add_contacts_to_audience
tools.description: Add contacts (by ID) to an audience.

tools.name: remove_contact_from_audience
tools.description: Remove a contact from an audience.

tools.name: delete_audience
tools.description: Delete an audience (list). Contacts are not deleted; only the list and its memberships are removed.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List dynamic segments. Segments compute their members from a filter expression at send time.

tools.name: preview_segment
tools.description: Preview the contacts that match a segment without sending.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List the workspace's events (meetups, workshops, conferences) with registered, attended and no-show counts and each event's public registration page.

tools.name: get_event_insights
tools.description: Who registered and who came for one event: counts, no-show rate, where people came from (city and state), first-timers vs returning, organisations and registrations over time. Without an eventId, returns insights across every event: regulars and their attendance streaks, cohort retention and the reg

tools.name: list_event_registrations
tools.description: List the people registered for an event, with status (registered, waitlisted, attended, no_show, cancelled), company, city and check-in time.

tools.name: register_for_event
tools.description: Register someone for an event. They get the event's confirmation email with their QR ticket unless the organiser switched it off, so confirm the person and the event with the user first. Registering doesn't subscribe them to marketing unless marketingOptIn is true because they asked.

tools.name: check_in_attendee
tools.description: Check a registrant in at the door (or undo it). Use the registration ID from list_event_registrations.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact's profile fields, custom fields, or subscription state.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact and all associated events. Irreversible.

tools.name: get_contact_timeline
tools.description: Get a contact's full activity timeline: emails received, events fired, opens, clicks, automation enrollments, topic changes.

tools.name: get_contact_health_score
tools.description: Get a contact's 0-100 health score based on recent engagement (opens, clicks, replies).

tools.name: send_broadcast
tools.description: One-shot broadcast: create a campaign and immediately schedule it to send, in a single call. Pass either an audienceId, segmentId, topicId, or fully-qualified filter. Provide html OR templateSlug. Before calling, confirm with the user: show them the recipients (or the recipient count), the sender an

tools.name: schedule_campaign
tools.description: Schedule (or send immediately) an existing draft campaign to an audience/segment/topic. Before calling, confirm with the user: show them the recipients (or the recipient count), the sender and the subject, and wait for a clear yes. Send16 can refuse a send. 429 SEND_RAMP_LIMIT: new and free workspac

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Update a draft campaign: name, subject, preview text, sender info, HTML content, and/or recipients. Retarget with exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll, then verify with preview_campaign_recipients before sending. Only drafts can be edited.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a sending campaign. Already-sent messages are unaffected; remaining sends halt.

tools.name: resume_campaign
tools.description: Resume a paused campaign. Confirm with the user first: the remaining recipients start receiving the campaign straight away. The sending limits and pauses described on schedule_campaign still apply.

tools.name: duplicate_campaign
tools.description: Duplicate a campaign (template, content, and settings) as a new draft; works on sent campaigns too, so this is the way to re-use a past campaign's design. Optionally rename and retarget in the same call (exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll). NOTE: without retarge

tools.name: delete_campaign
tools.description: Delete a draft campaign. Sent campaigns cannot be deleted (only archived).

tools.name: preview_campaign_recipients
tools.description: Preview the recipient set for a campaign before sending. Returns count + sample list.

tools.name: activate_automation
tools.description: Activate an automation. New events matching its triggers will start enrolling contacts. Confirm with the user first: once active it can start emailing contacts straight away.

tools.name: pause_automation
tools.description: Pause an automation. Existing enrollments freeze in place; no new contacts enroll.

tools.name: get_automation_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate analytics for an automation: total enrollments, completed, exited, open/click rates per step.

tools.name: list_automation_enrollments
tools.description: List active and historical enrollments for an automation.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces the authenticated user has access to (owner or member).

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get the current workspace (the one the API key belongs to).

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get the workspace's brand settings: colors, logo, fonts, and the DESIGN.md spec injected into AI generation prompts.

tools.name: update_brand
tools.description: Update workspace brand settings. The designSpec field is a Markdown DESIGN.md document fed into AI generation system prompts; use it to encode voice, do/don't lists, and visual rules. companyName/websiteUrl/companyAddress also fill the matching merge tags in templates.

tools.name: get_workspace_usage
tools.description: Get the current month's send count, contact count, and plan limits.

tools.name: list_suppressions
tools.description: List suppressed email addresses (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes, manual).

tools.name: add_suppression
tools.description: Add an email to the suppression list. Future sends to this address will be blocked.

tools.name: remove_suppression
tools.description: Remove an email from the suppression list. Use only when you've confirmed the recipient wants to receive mail again.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List configured outgoing webhooks (your endpoints that Send16 POSTs delivery events to). Outgoing webhooks are a plan feature.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an outgoing webhook endpoint. Send16 POSTs event JSON to this URL with an HMAC-SHA256 signature. Outgoing webhooks are a plan feature.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete an outgoing webhook endpoint.

tools.name: regenerate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Rotate the HMAC signing secret for an outgoing webhook endpoint. Returns the new secret once.
